VLLM_VERSION.description: Specific version of vLLM to install (numeric release version or alias such as latest or stable).

VLLM_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for vllm: 'libscript_native' installs into isolated versioned directories and 'system' delegates to the host OS package manager.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global unix socket to listen on

VLLM_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port for VLLM to listen on

VLLM_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Address for VLLM to listen on

VLLM_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Unix socket for VLLM to listen on

VLLM_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading vllm binary or archive artifacts.

VLLM_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying vllm available remote releases.

VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE.description: Target accelerator device backend for vLLM execution (e.g., cpu, cuda, rocm, or tpu).

VLLM_BUILD_TMPDIR.description: Temporary directory used when building vLLM wheels from source.
